raj: FYI: after the kernel-picker rules roll (v2) we see host-preproc p99 climb ~15-20% for short streaming requests over gRPC. Very reproducible on canary and small prod slice.

maria: ack, any flame/prof or quick perf numbers?

raj: repro: `wrk -c150 -d45 -s scripts/short-stream.lua`
pprof top (sampled):
```
proto_unmarshal   33%
writev_coalesce   24%
kv_cache_lookup    9%
batch_dispatch     5%
other             29%
```

raj: Observed change: short seqs previously chose `a64-fastpath`, now many pick `unified-quant`. avg_batch_size dropped 6 -> 2.5 on impacted hosts. KV hit rate for short flows fell 99%->88%.

sam: Do we know why unified-quant affects kvcache? Different key prefixes or metadata?

raj: Keys include kernel tag in prefix: e.g. `k:v:model:v2:kernel=unified-quant:hash=0x2f3e`. When kernel changes keys diverge. We see same logical requests mapping to different keys depending on kernel variant.

luis: Hypothesis: picker change changes batching hinting (seq histogram -> smaller batches) and kernel-tagged keys blow the kvcache distribution. Small batches => more syscalls & writev fragmentation => proto_unmarshal % rises because more small frames processed per second.

maria: Short-term mitigations?

sam: Options: 1) revert the seq<256->unified-quant rule, 2) make kvcache prefix kernel-agnostic for short-seq flows (stable-prefix), 3) increase gRPC write coalesce window from 2ms -> 4ms, 4) micro-opt proto_unmarshal for tiny frames.

raj: Ran a quick canary with picker rule reverted on 2 hosts: avg_batch_size returned ~5, p99 back to baseline. So rollback looks promising.

luis: I'll put together a branch for a fast-path in proto_unmarshal: skip full checksum/alloc path for frames <256B where header checksum matches quick-scan bits. Microbench locally shows ~18% lower cycle count for tiny frames.

maria: Good. Also please add metrics: `batch_size_by_kernel`, `kvcache_hit_by_kernel`, and `proto_unmarshal_latency_by_frame_size`. These should help correlate future changes.

sam: I'll open a rollback PR for the picker rule and a followup PR to bump gRPC coalesce window for host-preproc to 4ms (low risk). If revert buys us time, we can ship luis's fastpath and stable-prefix change.

deploy-bot: kernel-picker v2 rolled to prod at 6301111200 by infra-release. Rollback patch available.

maria: Thanks. Action list: revert picker rule (sam), stable-prefix PR (raj + luis), proto_unmarshal fastpath (luis), add metrics (sam). Run 1h wrk + pprof after each step. Tagging SRE for incident capture.

luis: note: stable-prefix needs careful TTL/versioning to avoid invalid cache poisoning. I'll add a canary flag to gate it.

raj: I'll collect KV prefix samples and upload heatmap/keys to the ticket.

maria: Great. Let's coordinate on the rollback PR now — if anyone sees further tail we revert immediately. :thumbsup:
